name: Elemental Hands (Mythic)
body:
Your targets suffer a lingering effect from your divine elemental energy.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Hands.

Benefit: A creature that suffers elemental damage from your fervor or lay on hands ability modified by the Elemental Hands feat acquires vulnerability to that type of elemental energy for a number of rounds equal to your mythic tier.
